description: Small labelled diagnostic pairs for the actual lexical narrative candidate method. Not a representative benchmark, training set, or coordination ground truth.

labels.same_narrative: The pair is annotated as referring to the same synthetic event/update; this does not imply coordination.
labels.different_narrative: The pair is annotated as different events/claims, including benign shared-topic controls.
